== Description ==

[[Mike Turner]] (front left, tan cap with sunglasses, black hoodie), [[Matt Thornton]] (back left, brown cap with yellow patch, beard, Galaxy's Edge tee), [[Steve Harpster]] (back center, white hair, glasses, grey tee, Apple Watch), [[Apollo Chu]] (back right, blue SpongeBob tee, curly hair, glasses), [[Justin Miyashiro]] (front right, black tee, white cargo shorts, red slides, glasses), [[Nathan Davis]] (background center, blue/yellow M cap, beard, black hoodie), and [[Garrett Larson]] (background center, pink cap, long beard, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
